data.short_description: Bean Our Guest plans to open a coffee café at the corner of Tujunga Avenue and Woodbridge Street in Studio City. The concept has been testing through pop-up events and will serve Puerto Rican coffee roasted by French roastery Torréfaction Gourmande.

data.status: coming to Six Corners this winter
data.short_description: Pita Inn is opening a new Mediterranean location at Six Corners, replacing the former Sears Auto Center, with signage now up. An exact opening date has not been announced. The chain also operates in Skokie, Wheeling, Glenview, Mundelein and Naperville.

data.status: upcoming; coming to the Hoffman Triangle
data.short_description: Cafe Tanjarine is an upcoming fast-casual restaurant serving plant-based and West African dishes alongside New Orleans fare. It will be a brick-and-mortar version of the Tanjarine Kitchen food truck, known for its Mandela Burger.

data.status: awaiting construction completion and final approvals, with plans to open by late fall
data.short_description: Bar Nostra, owned by Aakash Patel, will take over the former Mix Bar and Grill space in Center City. It will serve wood-fired international fusion pizzas, pasta, salads and clarified cocktails.
Heytea opened its first U.S. Gelato Lab+ store in Union Square, its fourth lab-format store outside China. The store offers eight gelato and sorbet flavors made fresh in-store.

Temaki Bar will reopen following a fire that temporarily closed the restaurant in early September. It is debuting a Phoenix hand roll with proceeds benefiting the Encinitas Firefighter's Association – Local 3787 through Oct. 31.
Moondog Pub & Grub, owned by Tommy and Felicia Burda, will close its doors citing financial challenges. The final day will feature performances by musicians Gus Garay and Erica Stelten.

data.location: 4612 South LeJeune Road, Coral Gables, FL 33146
data.short_description: Havana Harry's returns to Coral Gables after more than a year closed, with a refreshed look. It will initially open for lunch and dinner, with breakfast returning on December 1.
Waterfront restaurant Zio Fraedo's will close after 20 years of service. Owners Tony and Sherry LoForte cited rising rent and an inability to reach an agreement with their landlord.

data.status: opening timeline yet to be announced
data.short_description: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill is opening a new location taking over a former Del Taco in Morrow. The fast-casual chain serves Hawaiian-style plate lunches.

data.status: plans to remain in the space and expand its operations
data.short_description: Postern Coffee is taking over the full Minhwa Spirits space in Doraville. It will begin replacing distilling equipment with roasting equipment when Minhwa concludes service in November.

data.status: prepares to relocate; concludes service in November
data.short_description: Minhwa Spirits is preparing to relocate from its Doraville space. Postern Coffee will take over the full space after Minhwa concludes service.

data.status: will be closing its doors permanently
data.short_description: Zoto's Diner will close after 53 years of business. The property is planned to be demolished for a new Sheetz convenience store and gas station.
A new Sheetz convenience store and gas station is planned on the Zoto's Diner property. The diner property is planned to be demolished for the project.

data.status: hoping to open sometime next month
data.short_description: Kiara Nail Spa is coming to a plaza shared with Jewel-Osco in Chatham. It will be a full-service center offering nail and lash work, and owner Kim Tran is hiring staff.

data.status: shooting for a February 2027 opening date
data.short_description: The owners of Running Lab in Brighton are opening a second location in downtown Farmington. It is the team's first expansion since their 2011 debut.

data.status: signed a lease; still in the early stages
data.short_description: Barnes & Noble recently signed a lease at Moorestown Mall. An exact location within the mall has not yet been announced.
Barnes & Noble plans to leave nearby Eastgate Square in 2027. The move follows its new lease at Moorestown Mall.

data.location: Barn Plaza, 1745 S. Easton Rd., Doylestown, PA 18901
data.status: will open; official opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Pottery Barn will open at the redeveloped Barn Plaza shopping center. It will join the retailer's existing Pennsylvania locations including King of Prussia Mall and Lehigh Valley Mall.
EōS Fitness opens its eighth Mesa location and 48th gym in Arizona. The newly built 40,000-square-foot gym features the first Contender's Corner in Mesa.

data.status: planning to open early next year
data.short_description: Yahya Munsar of KJ Produce plans a Yemeni cafe in the former Shin Dig space. It will serve Yemeni coffee, pastries and house-made baklava, staying open as late as 10 p.m.

data.location: Next to KJ Produce, Fifth Avenue and Irving Street, San Francisco, CA
data.short_description: Abanico Coffee Roasters is opening a second location next to KJ Produce. The article notes it serves Latin American coffee.

data.location: 1500 Mt. Diablo Blvd., Walnut Creek, CA 94596
data.short_description: Bacio di Latte will open in the former Vineyard Vines space. The shop plans to offer more than 22 regular flavors, Ciocchinos, and an affogato bar.

data.location: 1500 Mt. Diablo Blvd., Walnut Creek, CA 94596 (corner space)
data.short_description: The former Vineyard Vines retail space is being divided into two units. Tea chain Chagee is planned for the corner space.

data.location: 11345 Legacy Ave., Building 11, Suite 300, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410
data.status: planning to open; opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Beignets & Brew is planning to open according to a Florida business license. The franchise serves made-to-order New Orleans-style beignets and specialty coffee.

Zov's may expand its Tustin flagship into a larger space next door, per a plan review. The flagship will stay open during construction, then reopen in an expanded and remodeled 8,200-square-foot space.
Yelp lists the El Torito that occupied the space as closed. Zov's is planning to expand into the space.
A fifth Zov's location is planned in the former Playa Mesa space. The opening is expected in late 2026.

data.status: opening at some point in November
data.short_description: Wonder, a multi-cuisine food hall concept, is setting up shop at 18011 Garland Groh Boulevard in Hagerstown. The company website says it will open in November, though no precise date is available. Locals report the location appears to have around 6 seats inside.

LongHorn Steakhouse is planning a new restaurant at 2800 Innovation Blvd, per a project registration filed with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. The site is part of Innovation Business Park in Hutto. No details on size, hiring, or opening date have been announced.

A business called The Yard might open at 1521 Mt Diablo Blvd, per a license application filed with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control. The application is tied to Jeffrey Dudum, co-founder of Diablo Restaurant Group. Menu, concept, hours, and opening date have not been announced.

SENA, a Marriott Autograph Collection hotel, will open at the OCVIBE development surrounding Honda Center. It will have more than 300 rooms and be the district's first hotel. Sage Hospitality Group will operate the property.

data.store_name: Signature restaurant from Chef José Andrés (at SENA)
data.short_description: The SENA hotel's ground floor will include a signature restaurant from Chef José Andrés. It will be open to hotel guests, district visitors, and Anaheim residents. The hotel is expected to open in 2029.

Mezza Mediterranean Kitchen & Tap is planning to open at 28120 Jefferson Ave. Suite A101, per a California ABC license application. The owners applied for a Type 41 on-sale beer and wine license for an eating place. Menu details have not been released.

data.status: aiming to open before the year is over
data.short_description: Flavor Hive, known for its walking tacos, is opening a new location in the former Five Guys space at 11500 Midlothian Turnpike. A Glen Allen manager says the restaurant aims to open before the year is over. No official opening timeline is available.

data.location: 13912 Ponderosa St., Suite L, Santa Ana
data.short_description: Los Vecinos Bar & Lounge is planning to open at 13912 Ponderosa St., Suite L, per a California ABC license application. It applied for a Type 48 on-sale general public premises license. No opening date, drink menu, or hours have been announced.

Springbone Kitchen, a New York City-based fast-casual eatery, is opening at 1333 14th Street NW in the former Slipstream storefront. No opening timeline is available. The location is not yet listed on the restaurant's website.

data.status: planning a new ice cream shop
data.short_description: Sorry, Not Sorry Creamery is planning a new ice cream shop at 208 Beach Blvd, Suite 110. The project became public through a plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency. No opening date has been announced.

data.status: on deck to begin greeting customers in November
data.short_description: Mehdi Zorgani is opening Pastiamo Osteria, an Italian restaurant, in a 2,614 square foot space that previously housed Elsa Ethiopian Kitchen. It will seat about 110 customers. There is no exact opening date, but the restaurant is expected to open in November.

data.status: certificate of occupancy remains under review
data.short_description: A restaurant registered as Memphis Finest Phla8bors BBQ 2LLC has filed a certificate of occupancy application for 629 Chelsea Avenue. It will occupy a 1,000 square foot space with an occupant load of 55. The application remained under review as of October 14.

data.status: appears to have a brick-and-mortar location in the works
data.short_description: Coffee shop Bearly Awake is eyeing an 875-square-foot ground-floor space at 572 Edgewood, Suite 122, according to a recently filed permit. The brand currently operates as a coffee cart pop-up around Atlanta. What Now Atlanta could not reach the team for more details.

data.location: 4390 Kimball Bridge Rd, Suite A, Alpharetta
data.status: will open in about a month
data.short_description: Saba Heydari and Sam Ramis, a husband-and-wife team, are opening Prax Cafe at 4390 Kimball Bridge Rd, Suite A. The space will fit about 20 to 30 people. It will serve coffees, cold drinks, sweets, and desserts with Persian touches.

Connie's Chicken is opening its fourth Mississippi location at 8220 Goodman Road, where construction is underway. The restaurant has launched a local Facebook page and is recruiting staff. It currently has locations in Oxford, Tupelo, and Starkville.

Michelin-recognized Tomo Japanese Restaurant is expanding to a second location next year. Tomo Sushi will occupy a 2,797-square-foot space in Downtown Alpharetta. It will feature a premium sushi bar and an outdoor space inspired by Japanese gardens.
N/A

data.location: 599 Beville Road, Suite B, South Daytona
data.short_description: According to a permit filing, Stoney Farms Seafood Restaurant (also known as Stoney Farms Crab Shop) is planning its second location at 599 Beville Road, Suite B. The family-run business serves crab, shrimp, oysters, and other seafood. No opening date has been announced.

Jordy's BBQ is preparing to open its first permanent restaurant in the 6,100-square-foot former Raíces Brewing space. Owner David Haskia plans a barbecue restaurant and sports bar. He hopes to open within two to three months if the build-out stays on schedule.

Moncrief Grocery & More is planned for the former Price Rite Food Store building. The proposed 2,100-square-foot store will be led by members of the family behind Holley's BBQ and will offer fresh produce and breakfast service. No opening date has been announced.
Price Rite Food Store previously occupied the site. It closed after the Jacksonville Sheriff's Office investigated suspected drug activity at the business.

Secret Pizza Jax is planned for 341 E. 8th Street in Jacksonville's Eastside neighborhood. A food-service licensing filing dated October 7, 2026 lists the business. The concept, menu, ownership, and opening date have not been confirmed.

A Bar Called PUP, a wine bar and restaurant from Katie Reeder and chef Justin Koontz, is preparing to open in College Hill in the former Kiki space. The concept will pair curated wines with a menu developed by Koontz. An official opening date, hours and full menu have not yet been announced.

Plans submitted by Hariras LLC show a new Tropical Smoothie Cafe in the works at Innovation Springs in Wesley Chapel. The menu ranges from smoothies to flatbreads to acai bowls. No opening date has been announced.

A plan review submitted by Stellapirelli LLC shows "Linea" opening at 465 Fifth Ave. S. in Naples, which signs point to being a fifth project from Campagna Hospitality Group. Chef Vincenzo Betulia declined to comment or confirm the project.

data.status: about to make a comeback / reopening
data.short_description: Opinions Sports Bar & Grill is reopening in Brooksville, with plan review documents submitted by Opinions LLC for 19201 Cortez Blvd. The bar posted on Facebook that "We are almost there!" Owner Devin Tocco was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: 3100 SW College Rd, Suite 334, Ocala, FL 34474
data.short_description: Plan review paperwork from Barry's Jerk Delight LLC shows the restaurant opening at Paddock Artisan Market in Ocala. The restaurant was previously in the Ocala Mall before it abruptly closed. Owner Barrington Carty was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: Near Keele Street and Lawrence Avenue, North York, ON M6L 1A7, Canada
data.short_description: Sunset Grill is preparing to open another Toronto location near Keele Street and Lawrence Avenue, listed on its Coming Soon page as opening in fall 2026. The franchise chain serves all-day breakfast and lunch. Exact address and grand-opening date have not been announced.

data.location: 1190 E. Commercial Blvd., Oakland Park, FL 33334, USA
data.status: initial plan review; application remains in process
data.short_description: Blue Willy's Barbecue LLC filed a DBPR initial plan review dated October 14, 2026, for a restaurant with seating at its former Oakland Park address. It has not been confirmed whether the filing relates to a reopening, renovation, change in occupancy or another project. No construction timeline or opening date has been established.

data.location: Lakeland Square Mall, 3800 US Hwy 98 N, Lakeland, FL 33809
data.short_description: Rural King will take over the former Sears anchor space at Lakeland Square Mall, vacant since 2018. The news was reported by ReutersConnect.com and shared in a local Facebook group.

data.location: 13450 S McCall Road, Port Charlotte, FL 33981
data.status: planning to open / signed a 10-year lease
data.short_description: According to Atlantic Capital Partners, The Sherwin-Williams Company signed a 10-year lease for a store at 13450 S McCall Road in Port Charlotte. Details on the opening timeline have not yet been released.

data.location: Continental Building, 150 E. Gay St., Columbus, OH 43215, USA
data.status: preparing to open; awaiting final building and health inspections
data.short_description: Toro Meat Market is preparing to open a downtown grocery store on the ground floor of the Continental Building, originally expected in fall 2025. A November 2026 opening is currently planned, though an official date has not been confirmed. The store will include a butcher counter, prepared foods, bakery, coffee shop and bar.

data.location: Waterside Shops, 5415 Tamiami Trl N, Naples, FL 34108
data.short_description: Anthropologie at Waterside Shops will close on October 18 to relocate within the mall. The store will remain closed for a month during the relocation.

data.location: Waterside Shops, 5415 Tamiami Trl N, Naples, FL 34108
data.short_description: Anthropologie plans to reopen in its new space within Waterside Shops on November 18 after relocating. The store offers apparel, home & furniture and beauty selections.
EoS Fitness is planning its first Hernando County locations, per the Tampa Bay Business Journal. A Brooksville studio at 14331 Cortez Blvd will open next year.

data.location: 13455 County Line Rd, Spring Hill, FL 34609
data.short_description: EoS Fitness plans a second Hernando County location in Spring Hill at 13455 County Line Road. It is set to open in 2028.

data.location: The Shops on Lane Avenue, 1555 W Lane Ave, Upper Arlington, OH 43221, USA
data.short_description: Pause Studio is preparing to bring its wellness and recovery concept to The Shops on Lane Avenue, listed as coming soon on its website. The franchise-operated studio, with Sarah Boyle among the owners, will offer services like infrared sauna, float therapy and cryotherapy. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: Near Grossmont Center Drive freeway exit, next to Guitar Center, La Mesa
data.status: opening a second location; working toward the opening over the next couple of months
data.short_description: Brute Force Games, a San Diego game store, announced a second location in La Mesa next to Guitar Center. The store said it would work toward the opening over the next couple of months. Its original store is at 3755 Murphy Canyon Road.

data.location: 1080 St. Clair Ave. W., Toronto, ON M6E 1A7, Canada
data.status: preparing to open; signage already installed
data.short_description: Mizzica Gelateria & Cafe is preparing to open its third Toronto location in Regal Heights Village, with signage already installed. An official opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 3189 Denton Highway, Suite 40, Haltom City, TX 76117, USA
data.short_description: Public filings show Wingstop could open at 3189 Denton Highway, Suite 40 in Haltom City. Records list construction beginning in late December 2026 with completion targeted for March 2027, though filing dates are not always definitive.

data.location: The Shoppes at Kingsgate, 1345 Kingwood Drive, Suite A, Kingwood, TX 77339
data.short_description: A TDLR permit shows CasaGela planning its first US location at The Shoppes at Kingsgate in Kingwood. Co-owner Alban Shahini said the plan is to open in Spring 2027, with Italian chefs making gelato in-house daily.

data.location: 451 Manhattan Beach Boulevard, Suite B110, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266, USA
data.status: targeting June 2027; timeline has not been finalized
data.short_description: Public filings show Bacari preparing to expand into Manhattan Beach with a small-plates restaurant. Co-founder Danny Kronfli said the timeline is not finalized but the restaurant is targeting June 2027.

data.location: Hilton Boston Park Plaza Hotel, 50 Park Plaza, Boston, MA 02116
data.short_description: London's Oblix is planning its first location outside the UK at the Hilton Boston Park Plaza Hotel, taking over the former Strip by Strega space. The proposed restaurant would accommodate up to 328 people and serve dinner and brunch.

data.status: preparing to open; targeting an opening before the end of November 2026
data.short_description: Blue Square Pizza founder Troy Sproul is preparing to open Lacy Burger, a smashburger concept, behind the original Blue Square Pizza location. Sproul confirmed the team is targeting an opening before the end of November 2026, with planned hours of 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.
